title: Table-top Tabbouleh
ingredients: 4 spring onions, trimmed and finely sliced
steps: Pour bulgur wheat and boiling water into a small saucepan; simmer covered for ~12 minutes until tender.
Fluff with a fork; cover again; rest 10 minutes. Spread on a tray to cool quickly if needed.
In a large bowl, combine spring onions, tomatoes, spinach, cucumber, garlic, parsley, mint and salt.
Add cooled bulgur; dress with lemon juice; mix thoroughly.
notes: A great base for any seasonal veg — sugarsnap peas, green beans, broad beans, courgettes, carrots, chillies. Use up leftovers.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
